summary: Procure ScribeHub annotation suite (50 seats) and onboard with SCIM/Okta SSO
description:
Issue summary:
Request to purchase 50 seats of ScribeHub (Annotation & Labeling SaaS) for Data Quality & Human-in-the-loop teams. Request includes SCIM provisioning, Okta SSO setup, and monthly invoice routing to Cost Center: DATA-ENG.

Impact:
- Teams: Data Quality, Annotation Ops, R&D evaluation squads (~35 active users initially, 50 seats to allow growth).
- Timeline: Needed for Q2 model evaluation sprint kickoff (deadline 2026-03-10).

Business justification:
ScribeHub offers integrated QA workflows and labeling telemetry that will replace ad-hoc spreadsheets and reduce labeling cycle time by estimated 25%. Centralized user provisioning via SCIM/Okta will reduce admin overhead for the Data Platform team.

Requested deliverables:
1) Purchase order and vendor contract signed for 50 named seats, 12-month term.
2) SCIM connector configured for automatic provisioning (Okta → ScribeHub).
3) Okta SAML/SSO configured and tested for two pilot groups.
4) Billing set to Cost Center DATA-ENG with monthly invoices to finance@redwood.com.
5) Security questionnaire completed and evidence attached (SOC2 docs, encryption at rest).

Budget and approvals:
- Budget owner: Lina Martinez (Head of Data Platform) - approval received via Slack thread #platform-procurement (link in comments).
- Estimated annual cost: $47,500 (vendor quote attached).

Vendor contact:
- Name: ScribeHub Sales (account rep: Jordan Meyers)
- Email: jordan.meyers@scribehub.ai
- Sales quote ID: Q-45678-RI (see attached PDF in Confluence link)

Deadline: 2026-03-10 (requested by Data Platform leadership)

Notes on scope: include SCIM provisioning for groups data-quality, label-ops, and research; restrict admin roles to one or two seeded admins; document retention and export policy to confirm ability to export labeling exports on-demand.
investigation_notes:
Vendor security review: initial questionnaire returned. Key items:
- SOC2 Type II: provided (Q3 2025).
- Data at rest encryption: AES-256 confirmed.
- BYOK/KMS support: not currently supported; vendor says customer-managed keys planned Q4 2026.
- Data residency: multi-region; default US. Legal asked for contract clause confirming no unauthorized data sharing.

Technical checks:
- SCIM endpoint supports group-based provisioning and SAML metadata uploaded successfully in test tenant.
- Okta test users created; SAML assertion mapping for email and displayName validated.
- API rate limits documented; recommended to use batched SCIM sync for >1k users (not required here).

Procurement blockers:
- Standard vendor contract uses 45-day payment terms; Finance requests net-30. Sales rep asked to accept net-30 in amendment (PR created).
- Legal requested an indemnity and data processing amendment; vendor negotiating.

Next steps:
1) Finance/Legal to sign off contract redlines (ETA 2026-02-22).
2) PO issuance by Procurement once contract countersigned (ETA 2026-02-24).
3) Identity team to complete SCIM SSO test in staging and promote to prod post-PO.
